Systemic Therapy Drug Schedule
===========================

The Systemic Therapy Drug Schedule module details the specific medications and dosing schedules within a systemic therapy course.

Data Collection Fields
--------------------

Drug Information
^^^^^^^^^^^^^
* **Systemic Therapy Link**: The treatment course this schedule belongs to
* **Agent**: Specific medication being administered
* **Route**: Method of administration

Dosing Details
^^^^^^^^^^^^
* **Planned Dose**: Intended medication dose
* **Administered Dose**: Actual dose given
* **Dose Units**: Units of measurement

Timeline
^^^^^^^
* **Start Date**: When this medication was started
* **End Date**: When this medication was completed

Special Considerations
--------------------

1. Dose Recording:
   * Document both planned and actual doses
   * Use consistent units
   * Note any dose modifications

2. Schedule Tracking:
   * Record all medications in combination
   * Note timing of administration
   * Document treatment breaks
